commit.subject: LU-12669 ec: EC feature test build (DO NOT LAND)
commit.message:
LU-12669 ec: EC feature test build (DO NOT LAND)

A test vehicle, not for landing. It squashes the open changes below,
at the patchsets listed, onto master 6325870717 (v2_17_60) so that
they can be built and tested together: every open change with both the
218_review_priority and pt_ecro hashtags as of 2026-10-22, plus the
changes marked * or +. It is refreshed as they get new patchsets.

68361 (LU-20690) stores EC parity as LOV_PATTERN_PARITY and no longer
accepts the RAID0|PARITY encoding of master, so EC files must be
created with this build.

Included, in apply order (change/patchset):
   69346/3   LU-12669 lov: keep EC read stripe errors per IO
   69349/6   LU-12669 ec: serialize concurrent EC recovery readers
   69350/6   LU-12669 ec: create lock placeholder for reconstructed
             pages
   69702/1   LU-20708 llite: rebuild faulting EC pages from parity
   69694/2   LU-20958 llite: only update blocks after a flush
   64086/47  LU-20958 lov: handle unavailable EC stripes in lseek
   69828/2   LU-20958 llite: drop strict SOM size with the UPDATE lock
   62868/3   LU-12187 llite: enable FLR EC support unconditionally
   69762/3   LU-20287 lov: don't block FLR RDONLY setattr on down OST
 * 69815/2   LU-20992 tests: skip sanity-pfl/28 for old MDS
   68747/14  LU-20718 ec: ignore stale EC fields from old servers
   68932/4   LU-20718 lod: scrub stale EC fields from old layouts
   69699/4   LU-20963 osp: treat disconnected OST as ENOTCONN in
             osp_statfs
   66882/39  LU-20211 mdt: trunc(0) layout replace on inactive stripes
   69508/3   LU-20897 lfsck: pass stripe index to OST PFID repair
 * 69304/5   LU-8933 obdclass: move RR target selection to
             lu_tgt_alloc.c
 * 69305/6   LU-8933 lod: balance round-robin first stripe start
   69421/5   LU-19823 lod: balance RR allocation across failure
             domains
   69422/3   LU-8933 lod: leave inactive targets out of the RR array
   69426/5   LU-19823 lod: spread failover groups over the RR array
   69697/2   LU-20967 osd-ldiskfs: name the failure_domain local file
   69111/10  LU-20797 llite: add SET I/O scope ioctl
   69516/6   LU-20690 lov: slot-based stripe geometry for EC parity
   69517/6   LU-20690 ec: implement STRIPE I/O scope
   69575/3   LU-20690 utils: per-stripe parity I/O helpers
   68361/16  LU-20690 ec: like-RAID10 parity layout
   69703/2   LU-20690 ec: verify parity against data, allow p > k
 + 69908/1   LU-12669 ec: fix degraded read page leak and short read
 + 69913/1   LU-20708 osc: let read faults switch mirrors on a bad OSC
 + 69914/1   LU-12328 llite: move a failed DIO read to the next mirror
 + 67613/4   LU-19994 ec: block LCME_FL_PARITY flag changes
 + 69493/2   LU-19823 lod: unique failure domains per EC raid set
 + 69824/3   LU-20212 obdclass: don't block no-delay statfs on others
 + 68204/3   LU-19631 tests: enable sanity-ec 12a
 + 69352/2   LU-20200 utils: report unreachable targets in lfs df -l
 + 64919/51  LU-12669 lov: slow and dead OST detection for degraded
             reads
   local     EC feature merge fix: 64919 with 64086 and 68361
 + 69709/1   LU-12669 lov: peer-relative deadline for EC raid set
             reads
 + 69710/1   LU-12669 lov: split EC reads at a raid set parity cannot
             cover

* untagged parent of a tagged change
+ untagged, added on request

local = fix for conflicts with master or between the changes, not in
Gerrit.

Conflicts resolved by hand: 69828, 62868, 69762, 66882, 69422, 69111,
69516, 69517, 69575, 68361, 69703, 69914, 64919.
